content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee is Donna Ball (E024), requesting write access to Source Code.

Two notes:
- HR note says: role Payroll Specialist, full_time, recommends write for Source Code (full-time max write).
- Security note says: role Payroll Specialist, contractor, basic training, recommends read. Security DB is authoritative for employment type.

Access policy:
- full_time: up to write; admin only if role owns system. Payroll Specialist doesn't own Source Code (Engineer does). So max write.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max read.

The Security note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type, and lists contractor with basic training. So max is read.

Requested level is write, which is above max (read). So grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
